fusions.name: Haymaker
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Weight
fusions.desc: Hurls a heavy weight that deals 32 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 6 tiles, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Forged Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds and your physical resistance by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Level Ground
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 15%.
